summary_md: **AI Adventurer ([@AiAdventurerx](https://x.com/AiAdventurerx/status/2115700164363194382))** shares **Octopus OS**, an MIT-licensed open-source agent harness in which agents can modify their own execution environment, built around a Rust kernel of roughly 45K lines ([miuuyy/Octopus-SI-OS](https://github.com/miuuyy/Octopus-SI-OS)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - miuuyy/Octopus-SI-OS: A self-evolving agentic OS. A new architecture for agent execution, built on operating-system principles, with the harness as a path toward superintelligence.

relevance: A self-modifying agent-OS harness design worth studying for harness architecture.
